achievement-1.title: Paper on Digital Forensics Case Management
achievement-1.description: Paper based on my master's thesis. Presents a framework and an open-source tool architecture for forensic case management that unifies procedural and technical requirements, ensures chain-of-custody integrity and separates forensically sensitive evidence from operational data. Validated via a proof-of-concept usability study.

achievement-2.title: Best Student Award
achievement-2.description: Awarded the NCR Atleos Prize for the student who achieved a high level of performance and is considered to be the best student overall from the MSc Ethical Hacking and Cybersecurity programme.

achievement-3.title: CCNA: Introduction to Networks
achievement-3.institution: Hochschule Ravensburg Weingarten • Cisco Networking Academy
achievement-3.description: Completed foundational networking training covering network technologies, routing and switching, IP addressing and network device configuration. Gained practical skills in establishing network connectivity and monitoring small to medium-sized networks.

reference-1.body: I have known Blue since his enrolment on the MSc Ethical Hacking programme at Abertay in September 2024, when he took my Digital Forensics class. Blue quickly stood out as an exceptionally capable student, bringing intelligence, diligence and thoroughness to every task. His approach to complex problems was mature, methodical and determined, underpinned by a genuine enthusiasm for the subject. It was therefore no surprise when Blue was awarded the NCR Atleos Prize for Best Student on the Programme. Beyond his academic strengths, Blue is thoughtful, reliable, engaging and easy to work with: a real asset to any team.

reference-2.body: Blue Butscher worked together in IT security and data protection related projects. Blue's contribution was highly valuable and useful: He provided great ideas and concepts, that he could very well argue for. His critical thinking skills supported by a good technical background made good judgement. He is able to do both: Good analysis of a status-quo as well as to develop ways to improve and augment any solution. While we worked together, Blue proved his curiosity in acquiring new knowledge and his ability to do so very fast. Blue is a trustworthy, reliable and highly committed team member. I therefore strongly recommend working with Blue.

reference-3.body: During his time as my student, he consistently demonstrated a strong work ethic, excellent attendance, and a genuine willingness to engage with both the course material and wider class discussions. He approached his studies with professionalism and maturity and contributed positively to the learning environment throughout. What particularly distinguished him from his peers was his attention to detail. He completed his work carefully and thoughtfully, often demonstrating a high level of precision. His commitment to producing sound work, combined with his enthusiasm for learning, made him a standout student.

reference-4.body: Blue consistently demonstrated reliability and professionalism. He was punctual, arrived prepared and ready to begin work. His self-directed approach meant he took initiative, managed tasks independently, and required minimal supervision. Blue also showed strong discipline and maintained steady progress on all assigned work. Overall, it was encouraging to see his commitment to producing quality work.

This website does not collect, store or process any personal data of visitors. This website does not use cookies or any form of tracking (incl. Google Analytics).

This website may contain links to third-party services such as LinkedIn or GitHub. When visiting those external websites, personal data and technical information, such as IP addresses, browser information or request data, may be automatically processed by the respective providers.

Please refer to their respective privacy policies for more details.
